title: clinopodium chinense var. glabrescens
intro: Clinopodium chinense var. glabrescens, commonly known as Chinese Clinopodium, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Clinopodium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which contribute to its ability to soothe and heal various bodily systems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities.
